Question: salaam, I got married last year and 1 week og my nikha, i was going to newyork, and the boder stop me on the way and i cant go for 5 years. i have 5month baby. my husband is not with me. he cant come where i live. now he is sponsoring me but its ganna take realy long. i miss my usband alot and i have seen him since last year. and he miss us too. plzzzzz give me some dua so i get sponsor fast and i get visa. and get to my husband safly. plzzz reply it fast. may allah bless u in this blessing month of rahmadan Answer ID: 8164 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1641/1560=D/1429) Recite the below duas, you will succeed in your goals, i n-sha-Allah: Three hundred times with durood before and after یا ارحم الراحمین Three hundred times with durood before and after یا حی یا قیوم برحمتک استغیث Three hundred times with durood before and after صلی اللہ علی النبی الامی فسھل یا الھی کل صعب بحرمۃ سید الابرار سھل Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
